command_line:
set -eu
RNAfold --noPS < "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79244494/inputs/dataset_2b3a7253-062a-4d85-99fd-deda173851b9.dat" > rnafold.out
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
lines = [ln.rstrip('\n') for ln in Path('rnafold.out').read_text().splitlines()]
struct = None
energy = None
for ln in lines:
    m = re.match(r'^([().]+)\s+\(\s*(-?\d+\.\d+)\s*\)$', ln)
    if m:
        struct, energy = m.group(1), m.group(2)
if struct is None or energy is None:
    raise SystemExit('could not parse RNAfold output')
Path('result.txt').write_text(f'{struct},{energy}\n')
PY
